patterns.note: Each typeface is presented as a full-width, vertically stacked section, featuring its name in an enormous display size, a brief description, and a curated set of images showcasing its character.
The site uses its own typefaces as the primary visual elements, with each section dedicated to a different font family, displayed at an extremely large scale to emphasize its unique design.

A minimalist palette of black, white, and light beige is used for most sections, punctuated by vibrant, contrasting colors (e.g., bright green, pink) for specific content blocks like the 'Journal' section.

The hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect as the user scrolls. As new sections enter the viewport, the large typeface names and associated content fade or slide into view from the bottom.

The top navigation bar transforms from transparent to a solid white background with a subtle shadow and slightly reduces in height after scrolling past the initial hero section, remaining sticky at the top.
The site employs a 'digital journal' aesthetic for its footer and specific content blocks, using full-bleed, vibrant colored backgrounds with editorial-style text overlays.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed background image with a subtle parallax scroll effect, where the image moves slower than the foreground content.
A sticky navigation bar is implemented that changes its visual style (shrinks, gains a background color and shadow) once the user scrolls past a certain point on the page.

Scroll-triggered animations are used to reveal content. As sections enter the viewport, elements like large text headings and image blocks animate in with a fade-up or slide-up effect, likely using CSS keyframes or a JavaScript animation library.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, expressive display headings (often full-width) are contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation, creating a dramatic visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous vertical spacing between major typeface showcase sections, with balanced internal spacing for content blocks.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its bold and unapologetic use of typography as the primary visual and artistic element. Each typeface is presented at an enormous, almost architectural scale, transforming the page into an interactive gallery or a digital journal dedicated to the art of type design, rather than a typical product catalog.
